outcomeStatistics.H: min(3, maximum consecutive physical-step duration satisfying all three strict predicates)/3; initialize current and longest durations to0; reset current duration to0 on any nonqualifying step.
outcomeStatistics.conditionalPeriapsis: maximum finite periapsis across every original post-action physical step satisfying strict apoapsis and vertical-speed predicates; use -PLANET_RADIUS=-6000 only if no eligible step exists.
outcomeStatistics.P: (min(800,max(-6000,conditionalPeriapsis))+6000)/6800; cap800 because it is the unchanged periapsis threshold shared by all3missions.
outcomeStatistics.candidateAggregation: Arithmetic mean across all6 completed flights, with no dropped failure, missing or no-eligible cases.
outcomeStatistics.duration: Use original physical dt=s.t-before, including50ms/250ms steps; H is measured from original physical outcomes only and never sets simulator phase or milestone flags.

arms.control: Original ordering: landings, then existing milestones in their exact current order, then original fitness. H/P recorded only.
arms.conditional_periapsis: Same landings and milestone ordering; then descending meanH, then descending meanP, then unchanged original fitness. Preserve original stable tie order. No epsilon or rounding for ranking.

training.initialState: generation0, episodes0, inherited frozen coefficient vector as mean, original scales, diagonal scale-squared covariance, no inherited best/history/covariance
training.selection: Freeze each arm’s generation4 selected candidate after every prescribed candidate flight has completed. No earlier-generation fallback, extra restart, early stop or case-based replacement.

comparison.selection: None; evaluate both fixed final-generation candidates on all6matched complete trips.
comparison.primaryReport: Report both arms and every pair: original stable-orbit/complete-orbit/return/landing counts, strict longest hold, H, P and each component physical deficit. Learning-metric gain without actual insertion remains a failed capability result.
comparison.secondaryReport: Original reward/fitness, old rolling quality, every failed endpoint, no-eligible cases, max conditional periapsis and full elapsed time. Do not pick one metric or case after seeing results.
comparison.capabilityRule: No release promotion. Report all outcomes. Improved P without qualifying H or original insertion milestone is still failed capability. Further independent JavaScript testing is required for any release claim.

preserved: 166700 neurons,25582938 directed edges,2 recurrent passes per decision
Fixed sensory basis and unchanged observation/motor interface
Original physics, all episodes to original endpoints, original success criteria
Style off, gain1, auto-odor off, native backend unchanged
All actions chosen by existing learned readout; reward statistics never enter observations or actions
prelaunchRequirements: Freeze exact modified trainer and instrument module, complete transitive runtime/resource/graph/native hashes, both starting checkpoint copies, case/environment/command manifests and analysis rule before launch.
Instrument BOTH arms and prove record-only instrumentation leaves previous recorded actions and complete physical replay unchanged.
Test strict boundaries and dt/reset/cap/no-eligible behavior with independent arithmetic fixtures; do not use guided flight examples.
Retain original metrics and milestone flags; version only experiment ordering/metadata.
limitations: The apoapsis/vertical-speed gate is discontinuous and can remove all eligible samples; the explicit no-eligible floor keeps these failures visible.
P may improve from a brief eligible crossing and does not establish three-second insertion; H and original milestones retain precedence.
MeanH prioritizes any real sampled qualifying hold gain over all meanP gains when milestones tie; mean aggregation can trade progress between cases, so all per-case outputs remain mandatory.
This does not add finite scoring for unbound tails or penalize deterioration after the best attained condition. It tests one demonstrated bottleneck rather than claiming to solve all reward defects.
Keeping actual milestone order means H/P only affect tied landings/milestone counts.
Single matched optimizer seed and six final cases cannot establish optimizer superiority, broad reliability, ground retention, or release eligibility.
Current13-axis family is restricted but no successful-policy impossibility or readout throttle floor has been demonstrated.

plan.purpose: Learn sustained proximity to the original three-second orbital insertion conditions after complete trajectory evidence of transient high scores and subsequent escape. No reward measurements enter controller inputs or actions.
plan.reward: After each original physics step, exp(-(max(0,800-periapsis)/200 + max(0,abs(apoapsis-destination)-200)/200 + max(0,abs(radialSpeed)-5)/5)), with zero for non-finite distance. Keep the maximum time-weighted mean over the trailing three seconds, padding early windows with zero. Orbital fitness uses 0.1*originalScore + 1200*holdQuality + 200*min(1,maxAltitude/destination). Preserve original instantaneous insertion metrics separately.
plan.physicalCompletion: Unchanged original launch, stable insertion, full revolution, deorbit, entry and safe barge touchdown. Every trip continues to its original endpoint. No reward value completes a milestone.

launchParameters.note: The launch command explicitly retained SUITE_TOUCHDOWN_MARGIN=3. This existing successful-touchdown penalty was omitted from the prose formula in the pre-launch plan; the original plan is preserved. For landed trips, fitness additionally subtracts 3*(vertical touchdown speed squared + lateral touchdown speed squared). Landing count and milestone ordering remain first.
